task: Add the canonical Wave 3 executable pre-review proof gate so implementation omissions and stale or weak evidence are rejected before reviewer rounds begin.
outcome: Running pre_review_check on a complete current worktree prints `Pre-review check: PASS plannedActual=complete executableEvidence=current mutations=biting transcript=related authority=admissible`; deleting a basis-backed topology path prints `Pre-review check: FAIL code=AT_UNMAPPED_SCOPE_REF` and blocks DEV-to-REVIEW.
facts: Waves 1, 1A, 2 and 2A are DONE on main at CLI 0.3.228.
Wave 2 acceptance_topology_check is the PLAN-to-DEV structural authority; Wave 2A critic receipts are CLI-verifiable and do not independently gate lifecycle.

VerificationEvidence already has canonical refs `evidence:<itemId>:<intentRef>:<index>` derived by acceptance-topology; manual_transcript evidence and the canonical live-smoke artifact provide transcript inputs.

AcceptanceCoverageBasisV1 and its signed receipt already support phaseBasis=`pre_review`, priorPlanBasisDigest, plannedActualReconciliations and current workspace hashes; Wave 3 should consume these instead of creating another inventory truth.
The narrow insertion point is transition-orchestrator before actor.send when target phase is REVIEW, alongside scope/guard gates and before the new review round is minted.

A verifier-owned signed pre-review check artifact is needed to bind recomputed basis/topology/evidence/authority/freshness, while the read-only evaluator and lifecycle consumer recompute/verify it; caller-written verdict fields remain forbidden.
Wave 3A selective applicability and Wave 4 measured rollout are separate scopes.
constraints: All gate-consumed facts need prompt guidance plus mechanical CLI/handler/gate enforcement and process-fact registration.
Callers cannot supply authoritative path inventory, authority, freshness or pass status.
DEV-to-REVIEW must fail closed on missing, partial, unsupported, stale or tampered basis/evidence.
Existing Stories and flat project modes must retain compatible observe/warn/enforce behavior; no Wave 3A or Wave 4 claims.
Focused production-path smoke must prove clean pass, adverse bite, exact restoration and no residue.
